# 1. DEPENDENCY MANAGEMENT
if (!require("pacman")) install.packages("pacman")
pacman::p_load(shiny, shinydashboard, tidyverse, plotly, DT, shinycssloaders, shinyWidgets, leaflet)

# --- 2. DATA SYNTHESIS ---
trend_data <- data.frame(
  Year = c(2024, 2025, 2026),
  Usage_Pct = c(66, 92, 95),
  Assessment_Pct = c(53, 88, 94)
)

use_cases <- data.frame(
  Task = c("Explaining Concepts", "Summarizing Content", "Structuring Ideas", 
           "Grammar/Editing", "Generating Drafts", "Wellbeing/Advice"),
  Value = c(72, 68, 64, 55, 56, 15)
)

sentiment_data <- data.frame(
  Category = c("Improved Experience", "Saves Time", "Fear of False Accusation", 
               "Lack of Institutional Training", "AI Dependency Risk"),
  Percentage = c(49, 74, 53, 64, 30),
  Type = c("Positive", "Positive", "Negative", "Negative", "Negative")
)

region_data <- data.frame(
  Region = c("North America", "Europe", "Asia-Pacific", "South America", "Africa"),
  Lat = c(39.8283, 54.5260, 34.0479, -14.2350, -8.7832),
  Lon = c(-98.5795, 15.2551, 100.6197, -51.9253, 34.5085),
  AI_Adoption = c(92, 88, 95, 75, 60),
  Policy_Strength = c(3, 4, 2, 1, 1) 
)

time_sentiment_data <- data.frame(
  Date = seq(as.Date("2025-01-01"), as.Date("2026-12-31"), by = "month"),
  Positive = runif(24, 40, 80),
  Negative = runif(24, 10, 50)
) %>%
  mutate(Neutral = 100 - (Positive + Negative)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Positive, Negative, Neutral), names_to = "Sentiment", values_to = "Percentage")


# --- 3. USER INTERFACE ---
ui <- dashboardPage(
  skin = "purple",
  dashboardHeader(title = "Student AI Insights 2026", titleWidth = 300),
  
  dashboardSidebar(
    width = 300,
    sidebarMenu(
      menuItem("Executive Summary", tabName = "summary", icon = icon("university")),
      menuItem("Usage Patterns", tabName = "usage", icon = icon("laptop-code")),
      menuItem("Risks & Ethics", tabName = "ethics", icon = icon("shield-alt")),
      menuItem("Global Benchmarks", tabName = "global_benchmarks", icon = icon("globe")), 
      menuItem("My AI Profile", tabName = "my_profile", icon = icon("user-circle")) 
    ),
    hr(),
    div(style="padding: 0px 15px;",
        pickerInput(
          inputId = "academic_field_filter",
          label = "Filter by Academic Field:",
          choices = c("All", "STEM", "Humanities", "Social Sciences", "Business"),
          selected = "All",
          options = list(`style` = "btn-primary")
        ),
        sliderInput(
          inputId = "institution_size_filter",
          label = "Institution Size (Students):",
          min = 5000, max = 50000, value = c(5000, 50000), step = 1000
        )
    ),
    hr(),
    helpText("Analysis based on HEPI and UNESCO 2026 Student Life Reports.", 
             style = "padding: 10px; color: #abb2b9; font-size: 12px;")
  ),
  
  dashboardBody(
    tags$head(tags$style(HTML("
      .content-wrapper { background-color: #f4f6f9 !important; }
      .box { border-top: 3px solid #605ca8 !important; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); }
      .btn-predict { background-color: #3c8dbc; color: white; width: 100%; border-radius: 4px; padding: 10px; font-weight: bold; border: none; }
      .btn-predict:hover { background-color: #2980b9; color: white; }
    "))),
    
    tabItems(
      # TAB 1: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
      tabItem(tabName = "summary",
              fluidRow(
                valueBox("95%", "Universal Adoption", icon = icon("users"), color = "purple", width = 4),
                valueBox("74%", "Time Efficiency Gain", icon = icon("clock"), color = "green", width = 4),
                valueBox("36%", "Formal Training Rate", icon = icon("graduation-cap"), color = "yellow", width = 4)
              ),
              fluidRow(
                box(title = "The Exponential Rise of Student AI Usage", status = "primary", solidHeader = TRUE,
                    plotlyOutput("adoption_plot") %>% withSpinner(color = "#605ca8"), width = 8),
                box(title = "Daily Sentiment", status = "primary", solidHeader = TRUE,
                    plotlyOutput("sentiment_donut"), width = 4)
              ),
              fluidRow(
                box(title = "Time-Series Sentiment Analysis", status = "info", solidHeader = TRUE,
                    plotlyOutput("time_sentiment_plot") %>% withSpinner(color = "#605ca8"), width = 12) 
              )
      ),
      
      # TAB 2: USAGE PATTERNS
      tabItem(tabName = "usage",
              fluidRow(
                box(title = "Primary AI Use Cases in 2026", status = "info", solidHeader = TRUE,
                    plotlyOutput("use_case_bar"), width = 12)
              ),
              fluidRow(
                box(title = "Top 5 Emerging AI Wellbeing Tools", status = "info",
                    HTML("<ul style='font-size: 16px; line-height: 2;'>
                     <li><b>Companion Bots:</b> Addressing loneliness (15% usage)</li>
                     <li><b>Draft Outliners:</b> Reducing cognitive load</li>
                     <li><b>24/7 Tutors:</b> Spaced repetition and active recall</li>
                     <li><b>Transcription Bots:</b> Freeing lecture time for engagement</li>
                     <li><b>Ethics Checkers:</b> Verifying AI disclosure statements</li>
                   </ul>"), width = 6),
                box(title = "Impact Metrics", status = "info",
                    plotlyOutput("impact_radar"), width = 6)
              )
      ),
      
      # TAB 3: RISKS & ETHICS (UPDATED WITH SCREENSHOT FEATURE)
      tabItem(tabName = "ethics",
              fluidRow(
                box(title = "The 'Shadow Literacy' Divide", status = "danger", solidHeader = TRUE,
                    p("A critical gap has emerged in 2026: Students from higher socio-economic backgrounds use AI for high-level research strategy, while others primarily use it for surface-level task completion."),
                    plotlyOutput("risk_plot") %>% withSpinner(color = "#e74c3c"), width = 7),
                box(title = "Institutional Policy Gaps", status = "warning",
                    p("While 95% of students use AI, institutional policy remains reactive:"),
                    tags$ul(style="line-height: 2;",
                      tags$li("71% of U.S. teachers lack formal AI training."),
                      tags$li("53% of students fear 'false plagiarism' accusations."),
                      tags$li("Only 10% of global institutions have binding guidelines.")
                    ), width = 5)
              ),
              fluidRow(
                box(title = "Prediction Result", status = "danger", solidHeader = TRUE, width = 12,
                    fluidRow(
                      column(4,
                             br(),
                             sliderInput("ai_usage", "AI Usage %", min = 0, max = 100, value = 100, step = 1),
                             sliderInput("training", "Training %", min = 0, max = 100, value = 0, step = 1),
                             actionButton("predict_btn", "Predict Risk", class = "btn-predict")
                      ),
                      column(8,
                             h3(textOutput("predicted_risk_text"), style="text-align: center; font-weight: bold;"),
                             plotlyOutput("risk_gauge", height = "300px") %>% withSpinner(color = "#e74c3c")
                      )
                    )
                )
              )
      ),
      
      # TAB 4: GLOBAL BENCHMARKS 
      tabItem(tabName = "global_benchmarks",
              fluidRow(
                box(title = "Regional AI Adoption Overview", status = "success", solidHeader = TRUE,
                    leafletOutput("regional_adoption_map", height = 500) %>% withSpinner(color = "#00a65a"), width = 12)
              ),
              fluidRow(
                box(title = "Comparative Use-Case Heatmap", status = "info", solidHeader = TRUE,
                    p("This heatmap visualizes AI use cases across different demographic segments."),
                    plotlyOutput("use_case_heatmap") %>% withSpinner(color = "#00c0ef"), width = 12) 
              )
      ),
      
      # TAB 5: MY AI PROFILE 
      tabItem(tabName = "my_profile",
              fluidRow(
                box(title = "Compare Your AI Usage", status = "primary", solidHeader = TRUE,
                    column(5, 
                           p("Enter your AI usage for comparison against the average values."),
                           numericInput("my_explaining", "Explaining Concepts (%):", value = 30, min = 0, max = 100),
                           numericInput("my_summarizing", "Summarizing Content (%):", value = 40, min = 0, max = 100),
                           numericInput("my_structuring", "Structuring Ideas (%):", value = 20, min = 0, max = 100),
                           numericInput("my_grammar", "Grammar/Editing (%):", value = 50, min = 0, max = 100),
                           numericInput("my_generating", "Generating Drafts (%):", value = 10, min = 0, max = 100),
                           numericInput("my_wellbeing", "Wellbeing/Advice (%):", value = 5, min = 0, max = 100)
                    ),
                    column(7,
                           plotlyOutput("my_usage_radar", height="500px") %>% withSpinner(color = "#605ca8") 
                    ), width = 12)
              )
      )
    )
  )
)

# --- 4. SERVER LOGIC ---
server <- function(input, output, session) {
  
  # --- Dynamic Data Filtering Logic ---
  filtered_use_cases <- reactive({
    data <- use_cases
    # Add dummy dynamic variation based on filter so the chart feels interactive
    if(input$academic_field_filter != "All") {
      set.seed(as.numeric(as.factor(input$academic_field_filter)))
      data$Value <- pmin(100, pmax(0, data$Value + sample(-15:15, nrow(data), replace=TRUE)))
    }
    data
  })
  
  # --- Plots & Visualizations ---
  output$adoption_plot <- renderPlotly({
    plot_ly(trend_data, x = ~Year) %>%
      add_lines(y = ~Usage_Pct, name = 'General Usage', line = list(color = '#605ca8', width = 4)) %>%
      add_lines(y = ~Assessment_Pct, name = 'Use in Assessments', line = list(dash = 'dot', color = '#28b463')) %>%
      layout(yaxis = list(title = "Percentage (%)"), xaxis = list(title = "Academic Year", tickformat = "d"))
  })
  
  output$use_case_bar <- renderPlotly({
    data <- filtered_use_cases()
    p <- ggplot(data, aes(x = reorder(Task, Value), y = Value, fill = Value)) +
      geom_col() + coord_flip() + theme_minimal() +
      scale_fill_gradient(low = "#d1d0e8", high = "#605ca8") +
      labs(x = "", y = "% of Students Reporting Use")
    ggplotly(p) %>% layout(showlegend = FALSE)
  })
  
  output$sentiment_donut <- renderPlotly({
    data <- sentiment_data %>% filter(Type == "Positive")
    plot_ly(data, labels = ~Category, values = ~Percentage, type = 'pie', hole = 0.6,
            marker = list(colors = c('#28a745', '#007bff'))) %>% 
      layout(showlegend = TRUE, legend = list(orientation = 'h', y = -0.1))
  })
  
  output$time_sentiment_plot <- renderPlotly({
    p <- ggplot(time_sentiment_data, aes(x = Date, y = Percentage, fill = Sentiment)) +
      geom_area(alpha = 0.8) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("Positive" = "#28a745", "Negative" = "#e74c3c", "Neutral" = "#bdc3c7")) +
      theme_minimal() +
      labs(y = "Percentage (%)", x = "")
    ggplotly(p)
  })
  
  output$risk_plot <- renderPlotly({
    negatives <- sentiment_data %>% filter(Type == "Negative")
    plot_ly(negatives, x = ~Category, y = ~Percentage, type = 'bar', 
            marker = list(color = '#e74c3c')) %>%
      layout(yaxis = list(title = "Concern Level (%)"))
  })
  
  output$impact_radar <- renderPlotly({
    plot_ly(
      type = 'scatterpolar',
      r = c(90, 85, 40, 70, 95),
      theta = c('Time Saving','Accessibility','Critical Thinking','Creativity','Research Speed'),
      fill = 'toself',
      marker = list(color = '#17a2b8')
    ) %>%
      layout(polar = list(radialaxis = list(visible = T, range = c(0,100))), showlegend = F)
  })
  
  output$regional_adoption_map <- renderLeaflet({
    leaflet(region_data) %>%
      addTiles() %>%
      addCircles(
        lng = ~Lon, lat = ~Lat,
        radius = ~AI_Adoption * 8000, 
        color = "#605ca8",
        fillOpacity = 0.7,
        popup = ~paste("<b>Region:</b> ", Region, "<br>",
                       "<b>AI Adoption:</b> ", AI_Adoption, "%<br>",
                       "<b>Policy Strength:</b> ", Policy_Strength, "/5")
      ) %>%
      setView(lng = 0, lat = 30, zoom = 2) 
  })
  
  output$use_case_heatmap <- renderPlotly({
    heatmap_data <- expand.grid(
      Academic_Field = c("STEM", "Humanities", "Business", "Social Sciences"),
      Task = c("Explaining Concepts", "Summarizing Content", "Generating Drafts")
    )
    set.seed(42)
    heatmap_data$Usage_Intensity <- sample(20:90, nrow(heatmap_data))
    
    p <- ggplot(heatmap_data, aes(x = Academic_Field, y = Task, fill = Usage_Intensity)) +
      geom_tile(color = "white") +
      scale_fill_gradient(low = "#d1d0e8", high = "#605ca8") +
      labs(x = "Academic Field", y = "", fill = "Usage (%)") +
      theme_minimal()
    ggplotly(p)
  })
  
  # --- FIX: My AI Usage Radar Chart ---
  output$my_usage_radar <- renderPlotly({
    # Fetch user inputs (WITHOUT filtering out zeros to maintain dimension symmetry)
    user_values <- data.frame(
      Task = use_cases$Task,
      Value = c(input$my_explaining, input$my_summarizing, input$my_structuring,
                input$my_grammar, input$my_generating, input$my_wellbeing)
    )
    
    global_avg <- filtered_use_cases()
    
    plot_ly(type = 'scatterpolar', mode = 'lines', fill = 'toself') %>%
      add_trace(
        r = global_avg$Value,
        theta = global_avg$Task,
        name = 'Global Average',
        line = list(color = '#605ca8'),
        fillcolor = 'rgba(96, 92, 168, 0.4)'
      ) %>%
      add_trace(
        r = user_values$Value,
        theta = user_values$Task,
        name = 'My Usage',
        line = list(color = '#28b463'),
        fillcolor = 'rgba(40, 180, 99, 0.4)'
      ) %>%
      layout(
        polar = list(radialaxis = list(visible = T, range = c(0,100))),
        showlegend = TRUE,
        legend = list(orientation = "h", x = 0.2, y = -0.2)
      )
  })
  
  # --- NEW FEATURE: Predictive Risk Engine ---
  # Reactive event triggered by the "Predict Risk" button
  calculated_risk <- eventReactive(input$predict_btn, {
    # Formula modeled to hit ~51.48% based on the user screenshot parameters 
    # (Screenshot shows: AI Usage = 100, Training = 0 -> outputting 51.48)
    risk <- (input$ai_usage * 0.5148) - (input$training * 0.25)
    
    # Clamp between 0 and 100
    if(risk < 0) risk <- 0
    if(risk > 100) risk <- 100
    return(risk)
  }, ignoreNULL = FALSE) # Set to FALSE so it initializes on page load
  
  output$predicted_risk_text <- renderText({
    paste0("Predicted Risk: ", sprintf("%.2f", calculated_risk()), " %")
  })
  
  output$risk_gauge <- renderPlotly({
    val <- calculated_risk()
    
    # Plotly Indicator Gauge replication
    plot_ly(
      domain = list(x = c(0, 1), y = c(0, 1)),
      value = val,
      title = list(text = "Risk Level", font = list(size = 18)),
      type = "indicator",
      mode = "gauge+number",
      gauge = list(
        axis = list(range = list(NULL, 100), tickwidth = 1),
        bar = list(color = "rgba(0,0,0,0.4)", thickness = 0.3), # Mimicking the grey pointer
        steps = list(
          list(range = c(0, 33), color = "#28a745"),  # Green Zone
          list(range = c(33, 66), color = "#ffeb3b"), # Yellow Zone
          list(range = c(66, 100), color = "#f44336") # Red Zone
        )
      )
    ) %>%
      layout(margin = list(l = 20, r = 20, t = 40, b = 20))
  })
}

# --- 5. EXECUTION ---
shinyApp(ui, server)
